about.heading: James & The Coastal Team
about.body: We're the Myrtle Beach locksmith who actually picks up the phone. When others say they're out of town or don't call back, we show up.

reviews.name: Maleia S.
reviews.text: Locked out Saturday afternoon. Spent an hour calling locksmiths who didn't answer or were out of town. Coastal answered right away and came out.

reviews.name: Joe M.
reviews.text: Visiting from Miami, locked out of my '73 Corvette Stingray. This guy unlocked it without any damage — impressive work.

reviews.name: Debbie G.
reviews.text: James got here on short notice at 9pm for a rekey. Made 3 extra keys on the spot. Very reasonable price, no gouging.
